items.title: Soft Sage Leaves
items.alt: Three oblong gray-green sage leaves on a short stem have softly wrinkled surfaces and a delicate velvety texture, rounded tips and complete small petioles, no flowers.

items.title: Rosemary Leaf Spray
items.alt: One compact gently arched rosemary twig has narrow needle-like green leaves with pale undersides attached along a woody stem, all needle tips and stem ends complete, no flowers or pine cone.

items.title: Holly Leaf Cluster
items.alt: Three thick glossy dark green holly leaves with crisp spiny margins attach to a short woody sprig beside three small red berries, natural botanical scale, no ribbon or bird.
items.description: Three thick glossy dark green holly leaves with crisp spiny margins attach to a short woody sprig beside three small red berries, natural botanical scale, no ribbon or bird.

items.title: Magnolia Leaf Pair
items.alt: Two large smooth elongated oval magnolia-style leaves overlap at their short petioles, one glossy dark green upper surface and one turned to show its warm rusty brown underside, no flowers.

items.title: Leaf Skeleton
items.alt: One complete delicate oval leaf skeleton with its outer outline intact, fine branching network of pale tan veins and a complete slender petiole, airy natural lace-like structure, no paper background.

items.title: Unfurling Tropical Leaf
items.alt: One small newly unfurling tropical leaf forms an elegant green rolled spiral blade on a slender stalk beside one short emerging leaf tip, fresh waxy natural material, no roots or pot.
